parsed.rationale: This is a regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS complexes, normal R-wave progression across V1–V4, and upright T waves. There is no pathologic Q wave, no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria, and no reciprocal change, so I could not confirm an anterior MI from the image.
